titles.romaji: Mob Psycho 100 REIGEN: Shirarezaru Kiseki Reinouryokusha
titles.english: Mob Psycho 100 REIGEN The Miraculous Unknown Psychic
titles.native: モブサイコ100 REIGEN ～知られざる奇跡の霊能力者～

description:
Reigen Arataka, the GREATEST psychic of the 21st century, tells us the 100% true, never before seen story behind some of his greatest supernatural feats. The world renowned psychic narrates his tell-all book in a retelling of the events in Mob Psycho 100.

(Source: Funimation)

Note: The OVA was screened at the Maihama Ampitheater in Chiba on March 18, 2018.
